title: America the Beautiful Quiz
description: Let's see what you learned about our wonderful country!

questions.question: How many stars are on the American flag?
questions.explanation: There are 50 stars on our flag — one for each state in America!

questions.question: Who was the first President of the United States?
questions.explanation: George Washington was our very first President! We call him the Father of Our Country.

questions.question: Why did the Pilgrims come to America?
options: To be free to worship God
questions.explanation: The Pilgrims came to America so they could be free to worship God the way they wanted!

questions.question: What Bible words are on the Liberty Bell?
options: Proclaim liberty throughout all the land
questions.explanation: The Liberty Bell has the words 'Proclaim liberty throughout all the land' from Leviticus 25:10!

questions.question: What song talks about America's purple mountains?
questions.explanation: 'America the Beautiful' talks about our country's purple mountains and amber waves of grain!
